envelope.description: Adopt a raw content write in LifecycleService.apply, with its unit cases

body.title: Adopt a raw content write in LifecycleService.apply, with its unit cases
body.summary: In LifecycleService.apply (src/workflow/artifact-core/lifecycle-service.ts), where checkIntegrity runs for approve, review and complete inside the store.updateAndLog callback: when it answers head-ahead-of-log, checkHeadIntegrity is ok and the head's content hash differs from the last revision-bearing entry's, append an 'update' entry for the head's revision and hash by insrc:system with outcome result 'adopted' through store.history.appendLog, then check again with the entry in the log and go on. The member check of a unit's completion (the same file, the member path) uses the same rule. Decide and test the order against a later failure of the same apply (an adoption stays in the log, which is in step with the head). Add the unit cases to lifecycle-service.test.ts with the store-kit and lifecycle-kit fixtures.
acceptanceChecks: A head moved one revision past its log by a raw writeArtifact content change is approved, reviewed and completed; the log ends with one adopted update by insrc:system at the head's revision and hash, then the operation's own entry

A hand-edited revision number (content hash equal to the last logged one), a hash-mismatch head, a log-ahead-of-head head and a raw write that restores the logged content are refused as before, with nothing written or logged
A head with no revision-bearing log entry is approved with no adopted entry; two raw writes in a row give one adopted entry at the last revision
An adopted entry whose append fails (a History that throws) fails the operation, writes no head and leaves a later attempt able to adopt
A Story completed with a member that has a raw content write is adopted or refused for the same reasons as a single head, shown by one unit case
The existing integrity cases of lifecycle-service.test.ts pass unchanged, and checkIntegrity, ArtifactStore.write and writeArtifact are not changed
